biotools.summary: RBPWorld is a resource exploring functions and disease associations of RNA-binding proteins across species, leveraging 998 RNA-binding domains and 87 RNA-binding Proteome datasets. It provides data on RBPs, RNA targets, regulatory pathways, and disease associations, along with an intuitive interface for easy access.
